```yaml
name: Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'

jobs:
  prepare:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '16'
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org/'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install --dev @changesets/cli @changesets/changelog-github

      - name: Configure changesets
        run: |
          echo '{ "changelog": { "outputFile": "CHANGELOG.md" }, "commit": true }' > .changeset/config.json
          echo '# Changesets Documentation' > .changeset/README.md
          echo 'For more information about changesets, visit [the official website](https://github.com/changesets/changesets).' >> .changeset/README.md

      - name: Update package.json
        run: |
          sed -i '/"bump:major"/d' package.json
          sed -i '/"bump:minor"/d' package.json
          sed -i '/"bump:patch"/d' package.json
          sed -i '/"bump:editors:.*"/d' package.json
          echo '"changeset": "npx changeset",\n"changeset:version": "npx changeset version",\n"changeset:publish": "npx changeset publish"' >> package.json

      - name: Move packages to ignore
        run: |
          echo '[{"name":"@ripple-ts/tree-sitter","group":"ignore"},{"name":"vscode-plugin","group":"ignore"},{"name":"sublime-text-plugin","group":"ignore"},{"name":"zed-plugin","group":"ignore"}]' > packages.json
          npx changeset add --config .changeset/config.json --packages-file packages.json

      - name: Remove bump-version.js
        run: rm scripts/bump-version.js

  release:
    needs: prepare
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '16'
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org/'

      - name: Authenticate with npm
        uses: DataDog/dd-octo-sts-action@acaa02eee7e3bb0839e4272dacb37b8f3b58ba80
        with:
          domain: 'github.com'
          audience: 'npm.pkg.github.com'
          scope: 'repo'
          policy: '{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["sts:GetServiceBearerToken"]}]}'
        id: octo_sts

      - name: Get npm token
        run: echo "::set-secret name=NPM_TOKEN::$(echo ${{ steps.octo_sts.outputs.token }} | jq -r '.token')"

      - name: Run changeset publish
        run: npx changeset publish --token $NPM_TOKEN
```
